Kashmir Police Chief Reviews Security for Film Festival

Inspector General of Police (IGP) for Kashmir, Vijay Kumar, chaired a security review meeting in Srinagar on Tuesday, ahead of the upcoming International Film Festival of Kashmir. The meeting focused on ensuring a robust security grid and heightened alert levels to maintain peace and order during the event. Officials discussed measures to prevent any untoward incidents and ensure the festival proceeds smoothly.
